requirements.name: World-local material function profiles
requirements.criterion: A selected recipe reads actual relevant properties and its resulting item supplies the promised function.

variants: Grain/orientation for handle or woven lining
Local magic conductivity for a supported substrate
details: Separate definition, counted stock and unique specimen only where needed.
Property has unit/local scale, tested consumer, discovery route and permitted substitutions.
Do not add dozens of inert fields to every native item.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native Recipe quality/tier exists; arbitrary material property predicate adapter is a gap.
acceptanceCases: Unknown material can be tested without exact UI disclosure
Tolerant substitute works if its function fits
requirements.remaining: Choose first material/recipe pair; no general specimen schema selected.

requirements.name: Material preparation and resumable work
requirements.criterion: Selected preparation changes real stock and pause/resume preserves its paid progress under declared terms.

details: Known batch remains idle; unfamiliar process needs only meaningful decisions.
Specify where unfinished work physically resides and who may resume it.
Local refund jobs are not evidence of generic partially consumed work.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Home dry jobs convert exact green/offcut keys; generic partial workpiece persistence missing.
requirements.remaining: First proof may retain atomic completion/refund; partial workpiece a later packet.

requirements.name: Purpose-specific measurement
requirements.criterion: Held means establish a reading with suitable uncertainty; only supported precision unlocks the selected fit.

details: Actual property and observer reading are separate.
Calibration changes confidence, not the specimen.
A certificate is attributed evidence; actor may verify it.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Stamped measured strip binds one observed sample; generic measurement/evidence intervals missing.
acceptanceCases: Wrong reading does not mutate truth
New sample invalidates old fit when relevant
requirements.remaining: Select measurement uncertainty policy per world.

requirements.name: In-game experiments and reusable evidence
requirements.criterion: A committed test uses held apparatus/sample and teaches only its observed conclusion without preview rerolls.

details: Freeze conditions and outcome seed only when chance is selected.
Useful inferior result, repairable work, recovered inputs and total loss are separate local outcomes.
Hypothesis form optional; known work never requires a science form.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Simulation knowledge receipts exist; structured test conditions and replication consumer missing.
acceptanceCases: Negative result rules out only tested conditions
requirements.remaining: First test needs explicit outcome/commitment contract.

requirements.name: Knowledge, practice, blueprint and operation
requirements.criterion: Learning a design opens an appropriate attempt; operating the completed object checks its real means separately.

details: Knowing what exists, knowing how, practicing and possessing apparatus remain distinct.
Memory decay/fuzzy transfer only if selected local rule or carrier requires it.
Teacher or powerful cheat can grant the actual supported stage directly.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Retained notebook adaptation consumes actual notebook; recipe-specialty bonus adapter missing.
acceptanceCases: Book title alone cannot supply physical tool
Teach one method without all craft mastery
Strong blueprint does not conjure materials unless cheat does
requirements.remaining: Use existing method owners; no new broad XP meter.

requirements.name: Toolmaking bootstrap
requirements.criterion: Each selected tool enables a concrete next operation instead of a nominal technology tier.

variants: Magical shaping directly substitutes where supported
details: Show known input and actual added capability.
Allow commissioning/borrowing/import to bypass a bootstrap link.
Source verification required before treating book technology as canon.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native station tiers gate recipes; selected function-specific tool gate needs adapter.
acceptanceCases: Missing file blocks only relevant operation
Borrowed tool works during valid custody
requirements.remaining: Pick one finite chain; no obligatory civilization ladder.

requirements.name: Parts, interfaces and adapters
requirements.criterion: A selected compatible part installs once; an adapter changes the named interface and usable function.

variants: Biological graft where source supports it
details: Definition revision, instance, mount and assembly identities distinct.
Dimensions, control signals and energy channels checked only if relevant.
A lore authority is not interchangeable with a battery.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native components/quality exist; dynamic nested instance installation/removal registry missing.
acceptanceCases: Part cannot be both installed and sold
Adapter does not equalize all world rules
requirements.remaining: Fixed variants can prove first interface; generic graph needs separate owner.

requirements.name: Function-specific quality versus scale
requirements.criterion: Improving selected quality changes its actual function, while expansion changes throughput under real constraints.

details: Native numeric quality remains incumbent.
No forced lower-tier niche or compulsory replacement.
Quality, condition, mastery, structural tier and quantity stay separate.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native quality ranges/caps and component tiers read skills; device-specific quality-to-function adapter missing.
requirements.remaining: Specify first function curve and show proposal numbers.

requirements.name: Repair, maintenance and salvage
requirements.criterion: Repair restores retained capability of an owned object; salvage consumes it and returns declared stock exactly once.

details: Wear/durability remains local opt-in, never applied universally.
Loan, installed part and reserved work are custody conflicts.
Recoveries reviewed across complete recipe cycles; no material multiplication.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Sharp→dull fixed variants and counted offcut/stave route exist; generic identity-preserving repair/salvage missing.
acceptanceCases: No repair and salvage same object simultaneously
requirements.remaining: Choose one object lifecycle; global wear not selected.

requirements.name: Facility access and construction
requirements.criterion: A completed supplied phase opens its named facility capability only while actual access supports it.

details: G3 owns entitlement/service terms; G6 owns physical capability and resources.
Incomplete frame has no completed facility output.
Moving or rebuilding preserves actual materials/claims under selected policy.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: compileSiteProject compiles finite DAG into existing claims/jobs; reusable facility capability registry missing.
acceptanceCases: Destroyed facility does not erase learned design
requirements.remaining: Start with local capability facts; general registry only if repeated consumer requires it.

requirements.name: Furniture and fixture useful lifecycle
requirements.criterion: Owned accessible furnishings supply their declared passive/active function; removal/lost access stops it without accumulated duplication.

variants: Drying rack active work and comfort
Drafting bench study and precise work
details: Acquisition, construction, installation, use, improvement and transfer have concrete contracts.
Duplicates, storage versus installed location and borrowed copies evaluated.
Proto23/native existing proposal numbers stay local; future fixtures can have distinct functions.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: furnitureProjection has idempotent owned/location projection; main rest/sleep/XP consumes it. General moving/dismantling not present in inspected fixture lane.
acceptanceCases: Unread or borrowed book excluded from owned-read contribution
Moving active fixture updates real consumer
requirements.remaining: Current absorption wave owns its gate; do not overlap it.

requirements.name: Stock, reservations and workshop capacity
requirements.criterion: Concurrent work never spends one input twice; explicit station and receiver capacity determine actual throughput.

details: Distinguish owned stock, reserved stock, available labor and physical capacity.
Queued intent cannot fabricate future supply.
G3 commission demand references actual committed output.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Retort accepted jobs validate exact stock and site reservations; arbitrary multi-output industrial optimizer missing.
requirements.remaining: Use finite jobs/plans; global solver not requested.

requirements.name: Energy and outputs for functional machines
requirements.criterion: A machine performs its promised operation with actual supported input, supply, throughput and destination.

details: Startup, throughput and reserves separate only where relevant.
Heat/strain is local authored constraint, not mandatory universal meter.
A sufficiently powerful source really meets demand.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Retort consumes exact fuel and receivers; power model scalar capacity exists. Durable multi-channel runtime device budgets missing.
acceptanceCases: Supported infinite source honors its scope
requirements.remaining: One fixed device mode can precede general budgets.

requirements.name: Automation and supervision
requirements.criterion: Selected automation repeats real operations only while supported and exposes its binding stop cause.

details: Native/manual alternatives remain reachable where means exist.
G3 owns wages/relationships; G6 declares operations operator can execute.
Offline advancement and absence policy explicitly selected.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing retort finite plan has explicit steps; general autonomous industrial scheduling/self-expansion missing.
acceptanceCases: Supernatural automation may bypass supervision if real
requirements.remaining: No universal attention-for-fragility tradeoff imposed.

requirements.name: Utility accessories and ordinary support devices
requirements.criterion: Each selected accessory changes the intended native action only when actually equipped or otherwise required.

variants: Survey lens or adapted body tool
details: Statless utility is still a real function.
Use inventory/equipment/custody incumbent; owning spare copies need not stack.
Allow superior or unusual variants where earned, with actual consumers.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Four source accessories expose adapters; Recipe and display/main station tiers consume selected utilities. No browser verification run here.
acceptanceCases: Portable station preserves better kitchen tier
requirements.remaining: Current absorption acceptance retained; future utility needs own consumer.

requirements.name: Connected precision-to-water journey
requirements.criterion: A built supplied pump opens a real water-dependent recipient action; its seal and operation matter.

details: Sample bore, choose seal, measure fit, build/test, install with rights, provide supply, deliver useful water.
Recipient can irrigate one supported plot or access an authored service.
No generic fluid network or global potable-water rule required.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: No pump consumer found in inspected source; exact selected device and recipient action adapter required.
acceptanceCases: Leak result changes delivered amount under local rule
requirements.remaining: Ready packet P1 below after G3 recipient contract and G5 transaction reservation.

requirements.name: Specialty-to-second-supplier journey
requirements.criterion: One taught supplier fulfills an actual later order using its own supported means and stock.

details: Maker specialty affects one recipe.
First accepted batch teaches only supported evidence.
Second supplier has actual capacity/stock; world reaction references real fulfillment.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Method knowledge/jobs exist; recipe-specialty adapter and supplier order consumer missing.
requirements.remaining: Ready packet P2; G3 owns orders/payment/worker writes.

requirements.name: Local preservation-to-delivery journey
requirements.criterion: Selected preparation preserves one local product long enough for actual delivery under declared clocks.

details: Batch age and transformation rule needed only for selected perishable family.
Useful residue or alternate use is authored, not automatic.
No universal expiry/hunger from this proposal.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native recipes support preparation; general batch age/spoilage transport consumer missing.
acceptanceCases: Mix batches under declared age rule
requirements.remaining: Later packet P6; higher persistence burden than P1/P2.

requirements.name: Environmental processing and site consequences
requirements.criterion: Selected weather/ecology event changes only causally supported material/site consumers.

variants: Local heat or atmosphere changes device operation
details: Explicit enrollment/support/window; no universal climate damage.
World instances select their own environmental rules.
Past event cannot replay after a late intervention.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native weather derives deterministic temperature/rain/light; material runtime joins one opted-in crop/drain and preserves unsupported windows. General ecology not present.
acceptanceCases: Late intervention changes current state only
requirements.remaining: Broader weather/ecology simulation remains continuation.

requirements.name: Resource geography and extraction
requirements.criterion: A selected source supplies its actual material through an accessible extraction or trade route.

details: Extraction permission/social response belongs G3.
Depletion/regrowth only if world selects it.
Substitution and recycling provide distinct routes when supported.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native material recipes/gathering foundations not exhaustively read; new resource stock/location adapter requires selected source.
acceptanceCases: Strong creation ability really supplies material
requirements.remaining: Full gathering catalogue intentionally unread.

requirements.name: Infrastructure and real public-service changes
requirements.criterion: Commissioned infrastructure changes an actual service or route rather than only regional adoption text.

details: Trace micro part→working installation→capacity→recipient behavior.
Recipients/institutions decide adoption by their means/goals, not a universal resistance tax.
Maturity and adoption separate; advanced pockets coexist with basic regions.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Finite site projects can author phases; generic service/adoption/region consumers absent in inspected files.
acceptanceCases: Native improvement may surpass player invention
High means may enable instant supported adoption
requirements.remaining: One bounded recipient first; global economy not needed.

requirements.name: Diffusion, standards and competing designs
requirements.criterion: A real taught/published/demonstrated method enables supported adoption or improvement by named actors.

details: Physical connector/measure standard G6; entitlement/reaction G3.
Copied known design still needs materials/tools.
Local authorities may fund, ignore, oppose or improve for actual reasons.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Knowledge receipts exist; generic method diffusion and standard interoperability consumers missing.
requirements.remaining: Select one observed transfer chain; no per-frame world gossip solver.

requirements.name: Cross-world compatibility experiments
requirements.criterion: Imported device, method or material retains its carrier and works only under actual local support, with meaningful adaptation routes.

variants: Source law blocks operation until real exceptional means
details: Separate possession, operation and reproduction.
No universal technology/magic suppression default.
Cross-world unknowns are original experiments unless verified canon.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Home notebook adaptation has narrow mundane consumer and physical carrier; generic compatibility/channel translator absent.
acceptanceCases: Strong compatibility cheat honors exact effect
requirements.remaining: World GM verifies local law before selecting outcomes.

requirements.name: Salvage and reverse engineering
requirements.criterion: Disassembly yields declared actual parts/evidence and only the tested knowledge necessary for reproduction.

details: Tamper protection/self-destruction only where source/device supplies it.
Missing manual vs missing tools vs missing exotic ingredient are separate gaps.
Known function need not reveal hidden operating principle.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Current count-based salvage patterns exist; general device specimen disassembly/evidence adapter missing.
acceptanceCases: Destroyed sample yields declared residue only
requirements.remaining: Select one ordinary public prototype; no sealed device details public.

details: Conventional tools not universal requirement.

No human-hand assumption imported into random alien starts.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Material jobs explicitly gate two usable hands in their local human scope; generic nonhuman/alien functional device adapters missing.

acceptanceCases: Absent specialist only stalls dependent phase

No equivalent suite reruns while authoritative gate already running.
